display.purpose: The net figure on the plate only; steps to 44px on phones when the formatted figure exceeds 10 characters.

headline.purpose: Page titles, sign-in title, the amount input on the transaction form.

title.purpose: Section titles, wordmark, money in / money out sub-figures on the plate.

body.purpose: Row names, form values, prose. Inputs go to 16px on phones.

body-sm.purpose: Period tabs, desktop nav, report tables, error notes.

label.purpose: Field labels, row meta lines, plate labels, section asides, small buttons.

caption.purpose: Badges and the chart's +/- max scale; phone tab bar labels use 11px.

strokes.name: rule-section
strokes.purpose: Opens a section; closes a table's total row.

strokes.name: tab-mark
strokes.purpose: Active period tab, desktop nav item, phone tab-bar item.

strokes.name: input-focus
strokes.purpose: Thickens the input border on focus; a stroke, not elevation.

motion.name: colour-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and active colour changes on buttons, tabs, inputs.

motion.name: bar-grow

components.css: .ds-rank { position: relative; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #111312); } .ds-rank-axis { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50%; width: 1px; background: var(--rule-strong, #111312); z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; } .ds-rank ol { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9dad5); } .ds-rank li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #d9dad5); } .ds-rank a { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; row-gap: 6px; column-gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 0; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-rank a:hover, .ds-rank a:hover .ds-rank-name > span { background: var(--hover, #efefea); } .ds-rank-name > span { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: block; width: fit-content; padding-right: 6px; background: var(--paper, #f7f7f4); } .ds-rank-meta { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-3, #676c68); } .ds-rank-track { position: relative; grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; height: 10px; } .ds-rank-bar { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; } .ds-rank-bar.gain { left: 50%; background: var(--gain-bar, #0b7a3e); } .ds-rank-bar.loss { right: 50%; background: var(--loss-bar, #d7261e); } .ds-rank-val { text-align: right; font-weight: 600; } .ds-rank-val.gain { color: var(--gain, #0b7a3e); } .ds-rank-val.loss { color: var(--loss, #c8231b); }

narrative.overview:
The app reads like the key-figures spread of an annual report. Each screen leads with one number on a chrome-yellow plate, and everything below it is printed on paper: ink type, 1px rules, and a ranked chart. The page is built from type, rules, and figures. It has no cards, no shadows, no gradients, and no decorative imagery. Depth comes from the rules and from contrast in type size.

Density is moderate and phone-first. Rows are about 44 to 52px tall. A page has one column inside a 1024px measure, and everything sits on a 16px gutter (24px from `sm` up). Hierarchy comes from the size gap between the 56px display figure and 15px body text, and only two weights are used. Colour is scarce on purpose. Yellow marks the single figure the screen exists to show. Green and red tell you which way money moved, and they appear only where money is printed.

Dark mode follows `prefers-color-scheme`. Paper and ink swap, while the yellow plate keeps the same yellow and the same dark ink, so the figure you came for looks the same in either mode.
keyCharacteristics: One yellow plate per screen, holding the net figure.
1px rules are the only containers. Corners are 4px or less, and nothing casts a shadow.
Geist with tabular figures throughout, in two weights (400 and 600).
Gain/loss colour appears on figures and bars only.
Signature: the ranked diverging entity chart on one continuous centre axis.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: Each screen has at most one yellow plate, and it holds the net figure for the current scope. Yellow is never used on buttons, badges, tabs, or highlights.

rules.name: The Money Colour Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only on signed money figures and chart bars, plus red for errors and destructive actions. Labels, status words, icons, and control fills stay in ink.

rules.name: The Constant Plate Rule
rules.body: Dark mode swaps paper and ink and leaves the plate as it is: same yellow, same dark ink.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 400 and 600 exist. Signed figures, titles, buttons, and active tabs use 600. Everything else uses 400.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, letter-spaced labels. A label is sentence-case 13px text in Graphite or Pencil.

rules.name: The Ruled Page Rule
rules.body: Containers are 1px rules. Lists, figures, and charts sit directly on the paper. Only forms and the plate are enclosed.

dos: Do give each screen at most one yellow plate, and put that screen's net figure on it.
Do contain things with 1px Hairline rules, open sections with a 2px ink rule and a 17px title, and mark active tabs with a 3px ink bar.
Do keep corners at 4px or less (3px on badges).
Do set every figure in Geist with tabular numerals at 600, signed, with gain/loss colour off the plate.
Do reuse the Entity Ranking for any comparison of entities, and keep its one continuous centre axis breaking around the labels.
Do keep the plate's yellow and its dark ink unchanged in dark mode.
donts: Don't use any box-shadow for elevation, or rounded white cards to wrap lists, figures, or charts.
Don't use a font weight other than 400 or 600.
Don't put gain/loss colour on labels, status words, icons, or control fills.
Don't use yellow anywhere except the one plate and text selection.
Don't add uppercase tracked kickers or eyebrows above titles or figures.
